subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill configuration action in `SKILL.md` metadata, and what dashboard URL/action trust policy should it enforce?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but turns skill-authored metadata into an actionable dashboard link, so automation cannot choose the permanent public metadata shape or trust boundary safely.

options.title: Define a typed config action
options.body: Add a schema-backed action with explicit allowed URL policy, label defaults, and relationship to `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub before implementation.

options.title: Use existing surfaces only
options.body: Direct skill authors to `homepage`, Skill Card, or plugin-hosted pages and decline a separate dashboard configure button for now.

options.title: Defer to plugin UI extensions
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/66944 own native configuration pages if maintainers want embedded plugin UI rather than skill metadata links.

recommendation.title: Define a typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a schema-backed action with explicit allowed URL policy, label defaults, and relationship to `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent skill metadata/docs history and the product/security nature of the URL contract make this the best available routing candidate from the inspected history.
